issues.reason: Possessive / genitive NP states that Possession is opaque and "covers ownership, kinship, and looser association alike without having to mean ownership", so in the reviewer's own gap territory (a proper-noun affiliation modifier) (Possession jirsa marshall) is true of "Marshall head coach" and well-typed, and the reviewer's "Jirsa is possessed by Marshall" reading is precisely the one the instruction set disclaims.

Sealing (Core patterns) puts a definite referent's typing atom at top level "beside the wrapper" and says to "decide each participant by its own determiner; do not put all typing atoms on one side or the other", and every sealing example seals P's predications only — so the definitional decomposition atoms (Inheritance head_coach coach), (Inheritance news_conference conference) and the definite typings (Member bob_hartley_big_green_room room), (LocatedIn bob_hartley_big_green_room cam_henderson_center), (Member cam_henderson_center center) do not belong inside the Theme term, which overstates what The Herald-Dispatch is asserted to have learned.

The reviewer's own q2 gap records that a predicative "as"-complement has no licensed encoding, and (Member jirsa head_coach) is entailed by "is being introduced as Marshall head coach" — losing the AS-link is under-specification in gap territory, not a false, ill-typed or over-asserted atom.

gaps_confirmed: predicative "as"-complement ("introduced as head coach") has no licensed secondary-predicate encoding; Resultatives covers only bare state/motion results
a proper-noun affiliation modifier on a common-noun head ("Marshall head coach") — Compound concepts excludes proper nouns from fusion and supplies no affiliation relation
a postposed evidential/reporting tail (", The Herald-Dispatch learned") — Propositional attitudes describes only a fronted attitude verb with a following that-complement
new_gaps: instruction-set tension on the verb "learn": Thematic roles' progressive test lists learn among the eventive mental verbs taking Agent, while Propositional attitudes prescribes Experiencer for its factive list, which includes learn
whether a containment link that is part of a definite description ("the Bob Hartley/Big Green Room OF Cam Henderson Center") projects out of a seal the way the Member/Name typing atoms do is unstated
repair_summary: Rebuilt the sealed Theme term of td65_learn_theme to contain only the reported proposition's predications, removing the two definitional decomposition atoms (Inheritance head_coach coach, Inheritance news_conference conference) and the three projecting definite-referent atoms (Member bob_hartley_big_green_room room, LocatedIn bob_hartley_big_green_room cam_henderson_center, Member cam_henderson_center center), all of which already stand at top level; nothing else changed.
notes: The factive dual-emit, the agentless passive with Ongoing, and noon -> (Hour 12) are all correct. The indefinite "a noon news conference" correctly keeps its witness typing inside the seal and, because learn is factive, also appears at top level.
